params.body:
## Inventory from the two S VehicleSearch API, brand landing pages, unavailable-vehicle flow

Five commits, in order.

### 1. two S VehicleSearch API as the live inventory source

two S delivered the API on 2026-10-12. `TwoSApiSource` sits behind the existing `VehicleSource` interface, pages through everything the shop has online and yields the same normalized array the scraper produced, so the importer, model and views stay as they are. A Basic-auth client reads its credentials from `.env` only. `php artisan twos:probe` is the first-contact command: master data with counts, online and offline totals, sample vehicles as JSON. `vehicles:import --source=api` is wired up and scheduled hourly with `--prune` once `TWOS_API_USER` is set.

### 2. Config from the first full pull

First real pull: 2.638 vehicles online, 14 pages of 200. `config/twos.php` maps body-type and branch ids to the fixed categories, rewrites make labels (DAIMLER-BENZ to Mercedes-Benz, country suffixes dropped, trade names title-cased) and translates fuel and drive where two S leaves the Dutch column German. Fixes found on real data: `vat` arrives as 1/0, dates as `0000-00-00`, location ids as `[35]`, VehicleType master data as an empty body; the Dutch colour category is preferred over the free German colour text; euronorm labels get the space the filter expects (`Euro 6e`).

Full import run locally: 2.638 available; listing, category pages, brand filter, detail page (21 photos, Product schema) and sitemap render.

### 3. SEO landing pages per brand and per category and brand

Clean, stable paths for the pages buyers search for: `/voertuigen/merk/scania` and `/voertuigen/trekker/scania`, in all five languages. A `?merk=` filter 301s to its clean path, also from the sidebar; the live filter script follows the redirect and pushes the clean path. Each landing page has its own heading, title and meta description per language, a short intro with stock count and year range, and related links with counts (other brands in the category, other categories for the brand). Pages with fewer than `seo.landing_min_stock` (3) vehicles stay reachable but carry `noindex,follow` and are left out of the sitemap. On today's stock: 97 brand and 116 category+brand pages in the sitemap.

### 4 and 5. Vehicles that leave the feed

No 404 and no redirect to the category (a soft 404 for Google, confusing for the visitor). For `seo.sold_grace_days` (30) the page stays up with "no longer available", the similar vehicles (same category and brand first) and a link to the category+brand page, with `noindex,follow` and SoldOut availability; price, call-to-action buttons, sticky bar and quote modal are gone. After the grace period the URL answers 410 Gone with the same alternatives. The wording is neutral on purpose: the feed does not say why a vehicle left. `sold_at` is set by the importer when a vehicle drops out of the feed and cleared when it returns. A legacy slug whose brand name changed (`daimler-benz-…` to `mercedes-benz-…`) 301s to the current slug via the stable id suffix.

### Tests

15 green: 5 unit (API source, with a faked API), 5 feature (landing pages), 4 feature (unavailable vehicles, 410, legacy slug, sold_at), 1 existing unit. `Tests\Feature\ExampleTest` was already red before this branch (the test database has no tables).

### After merge

- Set `TWOS_API_URL`, `TWOS_API_USER`, `TWOS_API_PASS`, `TWOS_SHOP_ID=2` in the Forge environment, run `php artisan migrate`, then `php artisan twos:probe` and `php artisan vehicles:import --source=api --prune`.
- Decide with Schoutteet whether the 107 "kraan accessoires" belong under Kraan or Onderdelen, and which house number is right (the DMS says 213, the site 211).
- Still open: photos stored locally as WebP, German free text on a Dutch site, rate limit of the hourly sync (undocumented, no errors today).
